name: Beselich (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red, white, red and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Beselich (a wavy bar, a fir and a tower on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Beselich; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Beselich arms — wavy bar, fir and tower
